theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 5 群

items.colloc: engage in 參與；engage with 與…互動
items.distinct: hire 僱用（人）| involve 涉及
ex: Employees are encouraged to engage in team projects.
公司鼓勵員工參與團隊專案。
We decided to engage a consultant for the launch.
我們決定聘請一位顧問來進行發表。
The new marketing campaign will engage more customers.
新的行銷活動將吸引更多客戶。

items.colloc: exactly the same 完全相同 | not exactly 並非完全
items.distinct: precisely 精確地 | actually 事實上
ex: That is exactly what we need for the report.
那正是我們報告所需要的內容。
The final results are exactly as we predicted.
最終結果與我們預測的完全一致。
I cannot say exactly when the system will restart.
我無法確切說明系統何時會重啟。

items.colloc: existing system 現有系統 | existing policy 現行政策
items.distinct: current 當前的 | available 可用的
ex: We must improve the existing process to save time.
我們必須改善現有流程以節省時間。
The company plans to upgrade existing software features.
公司計畫升級現有的軟體功能。
Replacing the existing equipment is quite expensive.
更換現有的設備費用相當昂貴。

items.colloc: extended deadline 延長的期限 | extended leave 長期休假
items.distinct: expanded 擴大的 | prolonged 拖延的
ex: The manager granted an extended deadline for the proposal.
經理批准了提案的延長期限。
Staff members can apply for an extended leave.
員工可以申請長期休假。
We received an extended warranty for all new computers.
我們為所有新電腦取得了延長保固。

items.pos: n. 燃料 | v. 刺激；激起
items.colloc: fuel consumption 燃料消耗 | fuel the growth 刺激成長
items.distinct: gasoline 汽油 | energy 能源
ex: Rising fuel costs are affecting our shipping rates.
燃料成本上漲正在影響我們的運費。
High demand helped fuel the company's rapid growth.
強勁的需求有助於刺激公司快速成長。
The factory needs to store more fuel for winter.
工廠需要為冬季儲存更多燃料。

items.colloc: highly recommended 強烈推薦 | highly qualified 高度稱職的
items.distinct: deeply 深深地 | strongly 強烈地
ex: Our new software product is highly recommended by experts.
我們的新軟體產品受到專家的高度推薦。
She is a highly qualified candidate for the position.
她是該職位非常稱職的人選。
The market is highly competitive in the technology sector.
科技產業的市場競爭非常激烈。

items.colloc: impose a tax 徵稅 | impose a deadline 強制設定期限
items.distinct: force 強迫 | levy 徵收
ex: The government decided to impose new taxes on imports.
政府決定對進口商品徵收新稅。
Do not impose your personal opinions on the team.
不要將你的個人意見強加於團隊身上。
Management will impose stricter rules on office hours.
管理層將對辦公時間實施更嚴格的規定。

items.pos: n. 影響；影響力 | v. 影響
items.colloc: have an influence on 對…有影響 | under the influence of 受…影響
items.distinct: affect 影響（動詞）| impact 衝擊
ex: Customer reviews heavily influence our purchasing decisions.
客戶評論極大地影響了我們的購買決定。
The CEO has a great influence on company culture.
執行長對公司文化有很大的影響力。
External factors could influence the stock market today.
外部因素可能會影響今天的股市。

items.colloc: inform someone of 通知某人關於… | keep informed 保持聯繫
items.distinct: notify 正式通知 | announce 公告
ex: Please inform the HR department about your address change.
請通知人力資源部關於你的地址變更。
We will inform all staff members by email tomorrow.
我們明天會透過電子郵件通知所有員工。
He failed to inform his boss of the delay.
他未能將延誤的消息告知老闆。

items.colloc: international market 國際市場 | international trade 國際貿易
items.distinct: global 全球的 | domestic 國內的
ex: The company is expanding into the international market.
該公司正向國際市場擴張。
We need to follow international standards for quality control.
我們需要遵循國際品質控管標準。
Several international partners will attend the conference.
幾位國際合作夥伴將參加這次會議。

items.pos: n. 講座；授課 | v. 演講
items.colloc: give a lecture 舉行講座 | attend a lecture 參加講座
items.distinct: speech 演說 | seminar 研討會
ex: The professor gave a lecture on modern economics.
教授針對現代經濟學發表了一場演講。
She will attend a lecture about digital marketing.
她將參加一場關於數位行銷的講座。
Our team was invited to lecture at the university.
我們的團隊受邀到大學演講。

items.colloc: maintain contact 保持聯繫 | maintain equipment 保養設備
items.distinct: sustain 維繫 | support 支持
ex: We must maintain high standards in our production.
我們必須在生產中維持高標準。
The maintenance team will maintain the office machinery.
維護團隊將會保養辦公室機器。
It is hard to maintain focus during long meetings.
在冗長的會議中很難保持專注。

items.pos: v. 見面；達到（要求）；迎接
items.colloc: meet a deadline 趕上期限 | meet the requirements 符合需求
items.distinct: encounter 偶遇 | satisfy 滿足
ex: We need to work harder to meet the deadline.
我們需要更努力工作以趕上期限。
Does the candidate meet all the job requirements?
這位候選人符合所有的工作要求嗎？
Our team will meet with the client this afternoon.
我們團隊今天下午會與客戶會面。

items.colloc: nearly finished 幾乎完成 | nearly double 幾乎翻倍
items.distinct: almost 幾乎 | roughly 大約
ex: The project is nearly finished after three months.
這個專案在三個月後幾乎完成了。
They have nearly double the sales of last year.
他們的銷售額幾乎是去年的兩倍。
It took nearly an hour to reach the office.
花費了將近一小時才到達辦公室。

items.pos: n. 訂單；順序；命令 | v. 點餐；訂購
items.colloc: place an order 下訂單 | in order 按順序
items.distinct: request 請求 | command 命令
ex: Please process the customer's order as soon as possible.
請儘速處理該客戶的訂單。
The files should be kept in alphabetical order.
這些檔案應該依照字母順序存放。
The manager decided to order new laptops for staff.
經理決定為員工訂購新筆記型電腦。

items.pos: n. 價格 | v. 定價
items.colloc: price range 價格範圍 | competitive price 具競爭力的價格
items.distinct: cost 成本 | fee 費用
ex: The price of raw materials has increased recently.
原物料的價格最近上漲了。
We need to price our services competitively.
我們需要將服務定價得具競爭力。
A lower price will attract more potential buyers.
較低的價格將吸引更多潛在買家。

items.colloc: on purpose 故意地 | for the purpose of 為了…目的
items.distinct: goal 目標 | intention 意圖
ex: What is the main purpose of this business trip?
這次出差的主要目的是什麼？
The purpose of this survey is to collect feedback.
這項調查的目的是收集回饋意見。
He did not arrive late on purpose today.
他今天不是故意遲到的。

items.colloc: positive reaction 正面反應 | reaction to 對…的反應
items.distinct: response 回應 | feedback 回饋
ex: The market reaction to the new product was positive.
市場對新產品的反應是正面的。
I am curious about his reaction to the news.
我對他得知這項消息後的反應感到好奇。
Public reaction will influence our next marketing strategy.
大眾的反應將影響我們下一個行銷策略。

items.colloc: recognize a problem 認清問題 | recognize achievement 表彰成就
items.distinct: identify 辨識 | admit 承認
ex: The company will recognize his hard work with a bonus.
公司將發放獎金以表彰他的辛勤工作。
It is important to recognize the potential risks early.
儘早認清潛在風險是很重要的。
I did not recognize him after all these years.
這麼多年過去了，我沒認出他來。

items.colloc: reduce costs 降低成本 | reduce the risk 降低風險
items.distinct: decrease 減少 | lower 降低
ex: We are looking for ways to reduce operational costs.
我們正在尋找降低營運成本的方法。
New safety measures will reduce the risk of accidents.
新的安全措施將會降低事故風險。
The company aims to reduce waste by recycling.
公司目標透過回收來減少浪費。
